description.en: Official China npm Skill with kling-plugin CLI for images, video and task tracking. OAuth login; generation uses regional account credits. China and Global accounts, credits and tasks are separate. Complete package required; UNLICENSED.
description.zh: 可灵国内版通用 Skill，npm 包含 kling-plugin CLI，支持图像、视频生成及任务查询。OAuth 登录；生成消耗对应账号积分；国内外账号、积分、任务不互通。需安装完整包，非单独复制 SKILL.md；许可 UNLICENSED。
